pages.title: Appaloosa
pages.text: Known for its leopard-spot pattern - the only breed whose coat always carries **dots**. Tough and athletic.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text:
Always with **Dots** markings:

- White + Black Dots
- Gray + Black Dots
- Chestnut + White Dots
- Brown + White Dots
- Black + White Dots
- Dark Brown + White Dots

pages.title: Where They Live
pages.text:
- Plains
- Wooded Badlands
- Savanna Plateau
- Sunflower Plains
